structure_and_depth.basis: The full manuscript goes beyond names and paper summaries. It first defines the work objects and dependencies of algorithms, feedback/data, evaluators, reasoning, environments and training systems. The methodological history then explains how DPO relocates work rather than eliminating feedback requirements, why reward evaluation is a distinct capability, and how reasoning and agents add verifier, environment and system dependencies. The people table separates direct contribution disclosures, team outputs, public employment periods and uncertain current status. The expertise matrix interprets those observations without inflating personal ownership. The timeline separates research events, publicly supported movements and corporate/academic name changes; the network retains both edge type and time instead of turning coauthorship into a timeless personal hierarchy. The ending uses these same distinctions to propose conditional combinations for behavior quality, verifiable reasoning, multilingual products and agents. Primary DPO contribution statements substantiate the theory/implementation/evaluation complementarity; Swallow explicitly distinguishes LLM training from instruction-tuning/evaluation responsibilities; HybridFlow's abstract states the training/generation and dataflow system problem invoked by the synthesis. Nathan's career account, Miranda's CV and the HKU alumni entry support the selected movement examples at different time precisions, while Trillium's announcement supports an organizational mission rather than delivered capability. Report sections 159-169 correctly explain that movement does not transfer whole organizational resources and localize uncertain records. The full report materially develops the previously reviewed outline into the required tables and relational analysis. Production history has an outline and one complete manuscript, and the actual retained first-draft difference only narrows a citation's claimed reading location; neither artifact counts nor that small editorial change are offered as research depth. No necessary structural or depth correction was found in the assigned scope.
